{"command": "git add test/discount.test.js && node --test 2>&1 | tail -12 && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
feat(discount): add SPRING15 code and make code lookup case-insensitive

Add SPRING15 (15% off) to the CODES table in src/discount.js.

Also normalize the code with String(code).toUpperCase() before lookup, so
"spring15" and "SPRING15" resolve to the same rate. Previously lookup was
case-sensitive, so a customer typing a code in lowercase got no discount
and no error. Existing codes (WELCOME10, VIP20) now accept any casing too.
Non-string input is coerced to a string, so undefined/null simply miss the
table and return the original price.

Tests (test/discount.test.js):
- SPRING15 takes 15% off (200 -> 170)
- lowercase "spring15" gives the same result as uppercase

No expiry handling yet; codes are still a static table with no end date.

Sade dil (teknik olmayan biri için):
- Ne yapıldı: Yeni "SPRING15" indirim kodu eklendi (%15 indirim). Kod artık
  büyük/küçük harf fark etmeden çalışıyor.
- Ne işe yarar: Müşteri kodu küçük harfle yazsa bile indirim uygulanır, "kod
  çalışmıyor" şikayetleri azalır.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF

Commit `92afb55` is made. Nothing was pushed.

- **Tests staged too:** Your test changes in `test/discount.test.js` were unstaged. I staged them so the commit includes them. All 4 tests pass.
- **`scratch.log` left out:** It's still untracked. It holds your note to ask Priya about expiry dates.
